reason: Two big customers cut orders last quarter and I already have the new market picked, so I need a pipeline there now, not next year. EUR 3,500 for the sprint is a small, contained bet for a company our size, so I'd try the sprint and decide on the monthly retainer once I see real meetings.
objection: Honestly, Apollo plus a junior SDR could cost about the same as the EUR 1,800 a month, and we'd own the know-how. The logistics case with 45 meetings doesn't tell me it works for a manufacturer selling into a new country, and with no guaranteed meetings I'm carrying all the risk on the retainer.
